description: An afternoon with Dr. Mona Hanna-Attisha, Representative Katie Dempsey, and other early childhood champions.In 2015, pediatrician Mona Hanna-Attisha exposed Flint, Michigan’s water crisis to the world. Ever since she’s been fighting for the children whose futures have been dimmed by lead poisoning.
